content: Scaffolding pattern for GitOps app onboarding: a small CLI/script that takes app name, image, port and renders templated manifests (kustomize base+overlay or Helm values) into the GitOps repo plus an ArgoCD Application, or relies on ApplicationSet git-directory generator so dropping a folder into the repo auto-registers the app (no per-app Application needed). ApplicationSet directory generator is the lowest-maintenance registration mechanism. Backstage-style IDP portals exist but are heavy for solo use; cookiecutter/copier or a bespoke script is the norm.
